description.value:
Your followers become experienced followers, and you gain your court's Court's Training benefit. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Followers.Item.Drsjs3tJmr7xVXvl] to your follower.

Hero's Heart Allies adjacent to your follower have lesser cover, and the follower gains physical resistance while guarding. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.actions.Item.AH3L1izPmDgXcy1h] to your follower.
